Ret:
RET-FASEN: rediger instructions/*.json-filer med edit_file - det er dit primare vaerktoj.

1. Brug locate(name="get_templates") for at se hvilke templates der findes.
2. Brug locate(name="_load_section_instructions") for at forsta hvor instruktioner loades fra.
3. Laes den relevante JSON-fil i instructions/-mappen (f.eks. instructions/selvforbedring.json) med read_chunk for at se indholdet.
4. Brug edit_file(path="instructions/...json", old_text="...", new_text="...") med den PRAECISE tekst fra JSON-filen.
5. Kopier ALDRIG tekst fra hukommelsen - kun PRAECIST fra read_chunk/locate.
6. KOR run_tests() - ALLE tests SKAL besta.
7. Hvis tests fejler: ret med edit_file og genkor.
8. Naar alle tests bestar: afslut med <<<DONE>>>.
en_ret:
FIX PHASE: edit instructions/*.json files with edit_file — it is your primary tool.

1. Use locate(name="get_templates") to see which templates exist.
2. Use locate(name="_load_section_instructions") to understand where instructions are loaded from.
3. Read the relevant JSON file in the instructions/ folder (e.g. instructions/selvforbedring.json) with read_chunk to see the content.
4. Use edit_file(path="instructions/...json", old_text="...", new_text="...") with the EXACT text from the JSON file.
5. NEVER copy text from memory — only EXACTLY from read_chunk/locate.
6. RUN run_tests() — ALL tests MUST pass.
7. If tests fail: fix with edit_file and rerun.
8. When all tests pass: end with <<<DONE>>>.
